title: crash-safe enqueue: .msg-before-.env rename order is correct
description: relay_queue.rs enqueue renames .msg before .env. The drain only processes .env files; a crash between the two renames leaves an orphan .msg with no .env, which the startup cleanup_orphan_msg_files scan moves to dead/. This ordering prevents the drain from reading a .env that references a nonexistent .msg. A future contributor might be tempted to reverse the order for 'simplicity' — do not. The ordering is load-bearing for crash safety.
